A few things nearby:
* **Model Homes:** About 950 feet east, Henry Doelger built the Rainbow House (1941) and Freedom House (1942) [Western Neighborhoods Project].

* **Old Photos:** The archive has two photographs pinned just 250 feet north of your corner [OpenSFHistory].

Street cleaning for your block is:
* **East side:** Mon 1st & 3rd, noon to 2pm (next: 2026-11-16) [SF Public Works].
* **West side:** Thu 1st, 3rd, 5th, noon to 2pm (next: 2026-11-19) [SF Public Works].
